g1_1_business.what_it_does: Radico Khaitan Ltd is a leading player in the Indian alcobev sector, primarily engaged in the production and sale of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL). The company has a strong focus on premiumization, offering products such as Rampur single malt, Jaisalmer gin, and Magic Moments vodka. It generates revenue through both domestic sales and exports, with a significant portion of its business coming from the domestic market.

customers.description: Individuals purchasing IMFL for personal consumption.

manufacturing.description: Home to one of India's largest malt distilleries.

competitive_advantage: Near-monopoly on armed forces canteen supply.
Demonstrated capital discipline with reduced debt.

drivers.title: Premium portfolio scale-up
drivers.fact: Rampur single malt + Jaisalmer gin growing 30-40% YoY.
drivers.why_it_matters: This growth in premium products contributes significantly to revenue and margin expansion.
drivers.evidence_quote: The premiumisation thesis — Rampur single malt, Jaisalmer gin, premium vodka — is a classic Lynch 'growth at a reasonable price' play.

drivers.title: OPM expansion to 20%
drivers.fact: Expected increase of 200-250 bps from scale and mix.
drivers.why_it_matters: Higher operating margins will lead to improved profitability.
drivers.evidence_quote: The OPM expansion from 11% to 17% confirms the mix shift is real.

drivers.title: New international markets
drivers.why_it.matters: Entering new markets will diversify revenue streams and reduce dependency on domestic sales.
drivers.evidence_quote: Exports are a growth vector, not the earnings driver.
